Avvocata, Montecalvario, Pendino, Mercato, Porto, San Giuseppe (Municipalità 2) — Naples, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Covers the historic centre's southern half, the port, and the Quartieri Spagnoli (in Montecalvario). The Naples Court of Appeal's own district report names "Avvocata-Pendino-Porto-Montecalvario" specifically among the areas with the highest concentration of "stese" (armed gang territorial-conflict incidents). The Quartieri Spagnoli themselves are mid-way through a genuine, funded regeneration: a Federico II University/Foqus urban-mobility plan (pedestrianisation, a revamped Piazzetta Montecalvario, new school capacity) began rolling out from September 2024, and tourism there has grown sharply — but the area is still routinely described in current visitor reviews as "caratteristico e pericoloso" (characterful and dangerous), and the underlying stese pattern documented by the Court of Appeal has not been reported resolved. Sources checked: Fanpage.it, 26/28 Jun 2023, citing the Naples Court of Appeal report; GrandeNapoli.it, 8 May 2024 (Quartieri Spagnoli regeneration plan).
